question: In October 2022, which among the following substances was mapped in abundance for the first time, by Chandrayaan-2, on moon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The X-ray spectrometer 'CLASS'** on the Chandrayaan-2 Orbiter has mapped an abundance of sodium on the moon for the first time, according to ISRO.
 
• The findings of the spectrometer were published in 'The Astrophysical Journal Letters' in the last week of Sept 2022.</li&g
